units: <cite ref="Yoma 70a:8">Yoma 70ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי להראות חָזוּתוֹ וכ׳</he> to show the people the beauty of it (his copy of the Law); <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 4:18">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:18">III</cite>), 18 <he>חֲזִיָּיתָן</he>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21b:15">B. Mets. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>חזותו מוכיח עליו</he> (masc.) the looks of the olive proves the owner; [Ar. Var. <he>זֵיתוֹ</he>].
